description:
Documentation must be provable fact. The `Certain` variant's doc comment at
src/compiler2/world.rs:2143-2146 says:

    /// A plain `fn`/`fnp`/`defmacro`/`defmodule`/`defprotocol`/`defimpl` head
    /// names the wanted name+arity statically: scoping this code is
    /// guaranteed to publish the function (or the reference is to a form
    /// scoping cannot change its mind about).

`code_surface_function_match` (world.rs:2149-2182) does the OPPOSITE for the last
three. `ScopeForm::Module`, `ScopeForm::Protocol` and `ScopeForm::ProtocolImpl`
sit in the catch-all arm at world.rs:2170-2175 that returns
`FunctionSurfaceMatch::None`, alongside Alias/Import/Require/Struct.

That is CORRECT -- none of those forms defines a GLOBAL function -- so the fix is
the COMMENT, not the code.

The only sources of `Certain` are:

    world.rs:2155-2159   ScopeForm::Function with matching name and arity
    world.rs:2161-2167   ScopeForm::CompilerService whose source defines the function
    world.rs:2219-2230   item_macro_call_match on a reserved macro head

## What the old ticket got wrong

Only its line numbers -- it cited world.rs:3072-3076 for the doc and
world.rs:3099-3105 for the arms. `FunctionSurfaceMatch` now lives at
world.rs:2136 and the arms at 2149-2182, and the `Certain` doc has also lost the
enum-position/rank framing the old ticket quoted, so a blind line-based edit
would miss. The substance was right.

## Checks

- The `Certain` doc lists only `fn`/`fnp`/`defmacro` heads, compiler-service
  sources, and reserved-head item-macro calls -- nothing the match arms send to
  `None`.
- No code change; lib green and clippy clean.
title: FunctionSurfaceMatch::Certain doc names defmodule/defprotocol/defimpl heads that the code routes to None
